top_story.headline: FBI Director Kash Patel amends stock-trade report to add a MicroStrategy purchase omitted for about six months
top_story.dek: An amended 278-T delivered to the oge@ inbox on Nov. 5 adds a $100,001–$250,000 purchase that was not in the original report.
paragraphs: Kashyap P. Patel, Director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation, amended his periodic transaction report (Form 278-T) to add a purchase of MicroStrategy, Inc (MSTR) stock on Nov. 21, 2025, valued at $100,001–$250,000. A Department of Justice cover letter dated May 28, 2026 forwards his May 26, 2026 amendment request. The original 278-T was signed Dec. 4, 2025 and certified by the U.S. Office of Government Ethics on Dec. 30, 2025. It listed one sale: ON Semiconductor Corporation (ON), Oct. 6, 2025, $50,001–$100,000.

Patel says the purchase was inadvertently left out because of a miscommunication. The MicroStrategy purchase was disclosed about 186 days after the transaction, well past the 45-day STOCK Act window, so it is a late disclosure. The report also notes that Patel received a 30-day filing extension. The document came from the OGE Form 201 requests filed automatically for the oge@markalfred.news inbox.

Also delivered Nov. 5: a certificate of divestiture for Todd Blanche (file 'Blanche, Todd OGE-2026-183-CDIV.pdf'). The summary available for this edition does not state his post or what he divested, so nothing more is reported here.

sections.headline: 10 ethics documents you requested have arrived from OGE
paragraphs: Delivered to oge@markalfred.news in answer to automatically filed OGE Form 201 requests. Summaries are of the documents themselves.

items: Kashyap P. Patel (Director, Federal Bureau of Investigation, Department of Justice): Amended periodic transaction report (278-T), dated 2026-05-28. Arrived Nov 5. A Justice Department cover letter dated May 28, 2026 forwards Patel's May 26, 2026 request to amend his 278-T signed December 4, 2025 and certified by OGE December 30, 2025. The amendment adds a purchase of MicroStrategy, Inc (MSTR) on 11/21/2025 for $100,001 - $250,000, which Patel says was inadvertently omitted because of a miscommunication. The original report lists one sale: ON Semiconductor Corporation (ON), 10/06/2025, $50,001 - $100,000. Late disclosure: The MicroStrategy purchase on 2025-11-21 was not reported until the amendment dated 2026-05-26, well over 45 days after the transaction. Worth a look: Omitted purchase: MicroStrategy (MSTR), 11/21/2025, $100,001 - $250,000; Original report lists a sale of ON Semiconductor (ON) on 10/06/2025, $50,001 - $100,000; Amendment requested May 26, 2026, about six months after the original was certified; Report notes the filer received a 30-day filing extension. OGE collection.

Todd Blanche (Not stated in the readable text): Certificate of divestiture. Arrived Nov 5. The file 'Blanche, Todd OGE-2026-183-CDIV.pdf' (1149421 bytes) is a certificate of divestiture under section 1043 of the Internal Revenue Code. The readable text is mostly standard language; the certificate number, issuance date, eligible person fields and the asset table (quantity and asset) are blank or unreadable. The attachment is signed by Scott A. de la Vega, Ethics Counsel. What was divested could not be determined from the text. OGE collection.

Farkas, Somers (Ambassador, Department of State): Periodic transaction report (278-T), dated 2026-07-01. Arrived Nov 6. Lists five transactions from 06/10/2026 to 06/17/2026. Three are purchases of $100,001 - $250,000 (Morgan Stanley Direct Lending FD, USD Michaels Cos bond) or $50,001 - $100,000 (Chemours Co bond). There is also a $100,001 - $250,000 sale of Legal & General U.S. Credit Fund (LUCIX) and a $1,001 - $15,000 sale of Enterprise Products Partners (EPD). Filer signed 07/01/2026; OGE certified 11/03/2026. Worth a look: Three of the five trades are $100,001 - $250,000 or $50,001 - $100,000 purchases/sales of credit-related funds and bonds.; Michaels Cos and Chemours bonds were bought 06/17/2026.. OGE collection.

Jinks, Kevin M (General Counsel, Privacy and Civil Liberties Oversight Board): Periodic transaction report (278-T), dated 2026-09-29. Arrived Nov 6. Reports one transaction: a sale of Vanguard Cash Reserves Federal Money Market Fund Admiral Shares (VMRXX) on 09/09/2026, valued at $1,001 - $15,000. The filer signed on 09/29/2026 and OGE certified the report on 11/03/2026. OGE collection.

Jayne, Thomas (Board member, management, Railroad Retirement Board): Periodic transaction report (278-T), dated 2026-10-02. Arrived Nov 6. Lists 14 trades from 09/25/2026 to 09/30/2026, each $1,001 - $15,000. Repeated trades include sales of General Dynamics (GD) on 09/25, 09/28 and 09/29, sales of Phillips 66 (PSX) and JP Morgan Chase, purchases of NVIDIA (NVDA) on 09/25 and 09/28, and Trane Technologies purchases on 09/30. Also sells W.W. Grainger and Illinois Tool Works. Worth a look: General Dynamics, a defense contractor, was sold on three consecutive trading days (09/25, 09/28, 09/29).; Trane Technologies purchase appears twice on 09/30/2026 (items 10 and 14), with different spellings.. OGE collection.

Kireilis, Althea A (Chief Operations Officer, Office of Administration): Annual financial disclosure (OGE 278e), dated 2026-06-12. Arrived Nov 6. Non-career appointee, appointed 03/2025. Lists NVIDIA stock ($1,001 - $15,000), small holdings in Apple, Amazon and Taylor Morrison Home, three whole life policies ($50,001 - $100,000 each), and cash of $15,001 - $50,000. Liabilities: a Rocket Mortgage on a personal residence ($500,001 - $1,000,000, 2026, 5.6%, 30 years) and two credit cards ($15,001 - $50,000 each, one at 19%). No outside positions, transactions, gifts or travel. Worth a look: New mortgage of $500,001 - $1,000,000 incurred in 2026.; Two credit card balances of $15,001 - $50,000 each (Citibank, Capital One).; Filer received a 30-day filing extension.. OGE collection.

Dowling, Maria-Kate (General Counsel, National Mediation Board): Periodic transaction report (278-T), dated 2026-10-01. Arrived Nov 6. Lists 15 transactions on 09/25/2026 and 09/29/2026. The largest are a purchase of iShares MSCI ACWI ex US ETF (ACWX) at $50,001 - $100,000 and a sale of First Trust Capital Strength ETF (FTCS) at $50,001 - $100,000. Other trades include purchases of an S&P 500 value ETF and a gold ETF, and 09/29 purchases of Blackstone and Boston Properties and sales of Carlyle Group, AMD and Starwood Property Trust. Worth a look: Bought Blackstone and sold Carlyle Group, both private-equity firms, on 09/29/2026.. OGE collection.

Howery, Kenneth A (Ambassador to the Kingdom of Denmark, Department of State): Periodic transaction report (278-T), dated 2026-09-08. Arrived Nov 6. Lists five transactions from 06/30/2026 to 08/20/2026. They include a sale of Airbnb (ABNB) valued at $5,000,001 - $25,000,000, a sale of Object Dash, LLC and a purchase of The Boring Company, each $1,000,001 - $5,000,000, and an exchange of "BIG3" Basketball NFTs for BIG3 HoldCo LLC units ($100,001 - $250,000), described as part of a settlement. Also a $1,001 - $15,000 sale of Instapray, Inc. Late disclosure: The Instapray sale on 06/30/2026 was reported on 09/08/2026, about 70 days later and past the 45-day limit stated on the form. Worth a look: Airbnb sale is in the $5,000,001 - $25,000,000 range.; Endnotes say the Object Dash exchange was reported on 1/30/2026 and was rescinded, and the Boring Company purchase refers to a 1/30/2026 report.; NFTs were cancelled and swapped for LLC units in a settlement, per the endnote.. OGE collection.

Prouty, David M (Member, National Labor Relations Board): Periodic transaction report (278-T), dated 2026-09-02. Arrived Nov 6. Lists nine transactions between 08/05/2026 and 08/26/2026, all $1,001 - $15,000. They include sales of DraftKings (DKNG), Fidelity Contrafund, JP Morgan Growth Advantage Fund and a Columbia Seligman fund, purchases of two First Trust Laddered Autocallable Barrier ETFs, and sales of SoFi Technologies $22 calls expiring 10/16/26, which the endnote describes as short sell / covered calls. Worth a look: Options trades: SoFi Technologies calls, noted as short sell / covered calls.; DraftKings sale and SoFi calls sale each appear twice (items 1 and 8, items 2 and 9) with the same date and range.. OGE collection.

Fagin, Steven H (Ambassador to the Republic of Yemen, Department of State): Annual financial disclosure (OGE 278e), dated 2026-03-17. Arrived Nov 6. Presidentially appointed, Senate-confirmed (appointed 04/2022). Largest holding is Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF at $500,001 - $1,000,000. Also lists Washington, DC residential real estate ($250,001 - $500,000) with rent income of $15,001 - $50,000, and two mortgages. No outside positions, transactions, gifts or travel. Worth a look: Mortgage on the Huntington Bank personal residence is $250,001 - $500,000 (2015, 3.875%); endnote says the property was rented out through May 2024, then became his residence.; Apple stock ($1,001 - $15,000) was inherited from his father, per endnote.; Investment-property mortgage with SDFCU is $50,001 - $100,000.. OGE collection.

sections.headline: No New Flagged Ethics Filings Recorded in the Reporting Window
paragraphs: The U.S. Office of Government Ethics recorded no newly flagged divestitures, terminations, or certified ethics agreements during the recent window.
Routine periodic and annual public financial disclosure filings received across various executive agencies are detailed below.

sections.headline: No new House filings in the window; Senate filings could not be checked
paragraphs: No new House financial disclosures turned up for filings since Nov. 3 that earlier editions had not already reported. The Senate electronic filing system refused today's search, so Senate filings are unknown. This is not a finding that none were filed.

blocks.text: Senate filings were not checked for this edition: the Senate's disclosure site (efdsearch.senate.gov) refused our automated search, so Senate stock trades and reports filed since 2026-11-03 are missing here, not absent. They will be picked up once the site allows access again.
